title: Turán-type and tiling problems in oriented graphs
summary: Given $a,b,c\in\mathbb N$, let $D_{a,b,c}$ be the tournament on $a+b+c$ vertices obtained by replacing the vertices of the directed triangle $C_3$ with transitive tournaments $TT_a$, $TT_b$, and $TT_c$, respectively. Keevash and Sudakov (2009) showed that every sufficiently large oriented graph $G$ on $n$ vertices with $δ^{0}(G)\geqslant (1/2-o(1))n$ contains a $C_3$-tiling, equivalently a $D_{1,1,1}$-tiling, covering all but at most three vertices.
